problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: Int → Int → Int)
-- inputs
(a b: Int) :=
-- spec
let spec (result : Int) :=
  |result| ≤ 81 ∧
  result % 10 = (a * b) % 10 ∧
  ((b%10) ≠ 0 → (result % (b%10) = 0 ∧ (result/ (b%10)) % 100 = (a%10))) ∧
  ((a%10) ≠ 0 → (result % (a%10) = 0 ∧ (result/ (a%10)) % 100 = (b%10))) ∧
  ((a%10 = 0) ∨ (b%10 = 0) → result = 0)
-- program termination
∃ result,
  implementation a b = result ∧
  spec result
